subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should reasoning presentation become a public configurable contract, and should its canonical ownership be portable agent-level presentation with channel overrides or Telegram-only configuration?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration and current architecture deliberately splits raw reasoning from channel-edge presentation.

options.title: Portable contract with overrides
options.body: Define a small core presentation enum and allow channel-owned overrides or capability mapping while preserving the current default.

options.title: Telegram-only configuration
options.body: Keep the shared formatter unchanged and expose only Telegram-supported presentation modes in the Telegram plugin config.

options.title: Choose one improved default
options.body: Avoid new configuration and replace the fixed italic presentation with one more readable portable default across supported channels.

recommendation.title: Portable contract with overrides
recommendation.body: Define a small core presentation enum and allow channel-owned overrides or capability mapping while preserving the current default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing italic contract, led the current agent-runtime ownership refactor, and have already provided direction on this issue.
